page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m4.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance consistently in the average performance tier for most standard operations. The CPU achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1828.39 and a multi-core score of 7717.41, while Geekbench returned a single-core score of 1417.0 and a multi-core score of 5300.0. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 426.16 GB/sec, dropping to 60.16 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. The instance demonstrates moderate capabilities in software compilation, with a Geekbench clang score of 8073.0, and static web serving throughput of 9.56 GB/sec. However, performance bottlenecks are evident in high-throughput database and machine learning tasks; Redis SET operations are weak at 7.81 million operations per second, and LLM inference speeds for a medium 7B model are poor, yielding only 15.99 tokens per second for prompt processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.u1-c1m4.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for standard enterprise workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or specialized accelerators. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance without the risk of resource contention common in shared-core environments. This instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, including moderate web serving, software compilation, text and image processing, and lightweight application hosting.
